$comment: Reference inputs of `ouaf preview` (#30): the frames a filter is rendered on when no --input is given. Each reference is a clip of this folder (file, relative to this file) rendered frame by frame from `from` to `time` (media time, s; the screenshot is the frame at `time`), or an image (file .png/.jpg/.webp, `frames` copies). maxFaces: faces the host tracks. Until the reference face set of #31 exists, they are frames of the licensed test clips (README.md); `ouaf preview --references <file.json>` takes another set in this format.

references.description: One face in close-up, frontal, mouth open
One face walking towards the camera, head slightly turned
Two frontal faces, one above the other
Underwater footage without a face (negative case)
